result.title: WAR-CRAFT: Refining Web API Recommendations through Requirement Auditing
result.summary: Web API recommenders return a set of APIs for a mashup request but do not check it against provider documentation, the main public evidence of an API's capabilities. The set can therefore contain unsupported or redundant APIs and miss requested capabilities. Filling every apparent gap does not fix this, because a gap may already be served, may not need its own API, or may have no documented provider. We study post-recommendation refinement, which revises a frozen recommender's output using only the request, the catalog, and provider documentation. We propose WAR-CRAFT, which treats refinement as three decisions. An LLM removes unsupported or subsumed APIs by judging candidates jointly, then audits the remaining set against a requirement checklist derived from the request. For each uncovered requirement, a fine-tuned catalog-constrained Resolver proposes a catalog API or abstains, and an independent documentation check admits only supported proposals. On ProgrammableWeb with 7 heterogeneous upstream recommenders, WAR-CRAFT raises mean SetF1 from 0.558 to 0.644, above the strongest of 5 refinement baselines (62.5%), and roughly halves functional redundancy (0.127 to 0.065) without changing mean functional coverage. Gains range from +2.2 points on generative recommenders to +18.2 on fixed-cutoff rankers. At matched set sizes, WAR-CRAFT still outperforms truncating the upstream output, so the gain is not explained by set-size calibration alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZsXu-enrico/WAR-CRAFT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究对冻结的 Web API 推荐器输出做后处理精炼：用 LLM 联合剔除无文档支持或语义冗余的 API，再依据请求生成需求清单进行审计，对未覆盖需求由受目录约束的 Resolver 提出候选或弃权，并经独立文档校验准入，在 ProgrammableWeb 上提升 SetF1 并降低冗余。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「先产出候选集合、再用外部证据审计、对缺口判断是否需要补充或弃权」的流程，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与是否继续 LOOK / 何时 STOP 的决策提供可核查的类比框架。
